Repo: llm-ai-search-seo (AEO Shopify app; base branch main; Firebase Functions packages/functions/src, Koa; jest from repo root). Brief: second-brain jobs/2026-10-06-security-backlog.md. Reference shipped in sibling seo: swaggerAuth exchangeToken binds integration.shopId (seo swaggerAuth.js:47-55) and reads the token from Authorization header first; internal support keys (internalAuth.js / internalKeyRepository, hashed, actor+ticket, audit) already exist in this repo.

Close cross-tenant shop writes via the shared integration key (brief E1, E2, E5).
- routes/proxy.js:51-61 guard /proxy/shop, /proxy/shop/update, /proxy/shop/locales, /proxy/checklist/default-scan-urls, /proxy/links/sync|stop|status with validateAccessToken, which accepts the 2 app-wide integrationKeys (no shopId) and takes the store from a header. /proxy/shop/update -> updateShopData (repositories/shopRepository.js:94) uses a blocklist ['plan','isDevZone','installedAt'] that shrinks when the body sends isDevZone:true, so a key holder writes any field on any shop doc.
  * Delete POST /proxy/shop/update.
  * For the other routes: if the equivalent /api/* route is in the internal-key allowlist (swaggerAuth INTERNAL_ROUTES ~19-37), delete the /proxy route; otherwise move it behind an internal-key guard (getActiveInternalKey from Authorization: Bearer, required actor+ticket headers, recordInternalKeyUse for non-GET) — reuse code from internalAuth.js, do not invent a new credential.
  * Delete /proxy/abc (dead).
  * If updateShopData's blocklist is still reachable from any remaining route, convert it to an allowlist for that caller.
- middleware/swaggerAuth.js exchangeToken (~56-110): read the key only from the X-SEO-Access-Token or Authorization header (query -> 400), require integration.shopId === resolved shop id (403 otherwise; both current keys have no shopId and stop working — intended), and verifySwaggerToken (~137-152) re-checks credential.shopId === decoded shop on every request.
- controllers/devController.js ~57 GET /api/dev/integration-token returns the plaintext app-wide key: delete route + handler.
- Tests: exchangeToken (bound key other shop -> 403, query token -> 400); routes source pin (/proxy/shop/update, /proxy/abc, /api/dev/integration-token absent; remaining /proxy routes not on validateAccessToken).

Test files (exact paths): packages/functions/src/__tests__/proxyRoutes.security.test.js and packages/functions/src/__tests__/swaggerAuth.exchangeToken.test.js. Note: packages/functions/src/__tests__/llmsTxtTranslatedDescription.test.js already fails on main — not yours, do not touch it.
